entries.name: Blocky character A
entries.style: blocky low-poly (six cuboids), Minecraft-like skin texture flattened to flat colours (Kenney 2025)

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Blocky Characters 2.0, GLB member with its Textures/texture-a.png (all 27 clips are node tracks inside the GLB; rigid parts, no skin, so the Blender path keeps them intact). 1.1 m tall to match the Kenney mini characters: the head is about a quarter of the body, so a real adult height would make it 0.45 m; 1.1 m keeps it near real size. Each cube face is two triangles and the texture is flattened per triangle, so the painted face (eyes, beard) is lost: the head reads as a skin front with grey hair on top and back, and each side splits diagonally into skin (ear) and hair. Noon script with the mini characters' role pairs (tunic as shirt, green trousers as denim). Ground: moving and falling clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are authored seated at chair height and are lowered onto the ground plane (set their lift to 0 to seat him on a chair or wheelchair).
